tool.help:
**RECAP-PROK Functional Annotation Comparison**
This tool compares multiple layers of functional annotation between re-annotated and reference-mapped protein sets.
Inputs ------
- Re-annotated eggNOG-mapper annotations - Reference-mapped eggNOG-mapper annotations - Re-annotated protein FASTA - Reference-mapped protein FASTA
The protein FASTA files are used to determine the total number of proteins and proteins not represented in the eggNOG-mapper annotation tables.
Reported metrics ----------------
- Total proteins - COG known-function assignments - COG unknown-function assignments - No COG hit - Missing from the eggNOG-mapper annotation table - Proteins with KEGG KO annotation - Unique KEGG orthology identifiers - Proteins with Gene Ontology Biological Process annotations - Proteins with Gene Ontology Molecular Function annotations - Proteins with Gene Ontology Cellular Component annotations
GO identifiers are classified into BP, MF, and CC namespaces using the Gene Ontology reference selected from the Galaxy ``gene_ontology`` data table.
The eggNOG-mapper tables must contain the ``#query``, ``COG_category``, ``GOs``, and ``KEGG_ko`` columns.
This tool does not run eggNOG-mapper itself.
